recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man in a cowboy hat framed by the window of a weathered blue truck, featuring a high-contrast vertical typographic sidebar and a secondary text block anchored by a white foreground element.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed within the geometric lines of a vehicle window
High-contrast black sidebar balancing the organic portrait
Color coordination between the truck's blue and the subject's shirt
Vertical text orientation creating a strong right-side anchor
coreInvariants: Weathered light blue texture on the vehicle
90-degree rotated display typography on the right margin
Soft white gradient overlay in the bottom right corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, positioned within the truck cab.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy black vertical bar on the right edge serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the hand on the window frame, then sweep up the vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The black sidebar provides functional negative space for large-scale branding.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue (vehicle and shirt) provides the primary thematic tone.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (sidebar and hat) creates depth and framing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mustard yellow/gold (text accents) provides warmth and focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, natural saturation in the photo contrasted with flat, high-value white and gold text.

letterConstructionRules: Primary display text is rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise
Secondary text uses a mix of serif capitals and fluid script
Tight letter spacing on the vertical display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Specific vowels in the vertical text are filled with accent gold color
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric sans-serif for impact paired with a delicate formal script for elegance.

preserve: Gold color accents on specific letters
avoid: Horizontal placement for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric clarity for the vertical sidebar.
Matches the fluid, formal contrast needed for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A portrait of a man with a cowboy hat looking out of a vintage blue truck window. The truck has chipped paint. A solid black vertical bar is on the right edge. A soft white glow emanates from the bottom right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large vertical bold sans-serif text inside the black bar, rotating it 270 degrees. Color some letters gold. Add a three-line text block in the bottom right using a mix of script and serif fonts.

verificationChecks: Is the main text rotated vertically?
Does the blue of the truck match the blue in the shirt?
Is there a clear black sidebar on the right?
Are gold accents used sparingly within the text?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (gold can be swapped for silver or copper)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced weight between the photo and the sidebar

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical text is legible and not cut off.
Verify the white gradient doesn't obscure the subject's hand.
Check that the script font is readable against the white background.
Confirm the black sidebar is perfectly vertical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait in vehicle window + Vertical high-contrast sidebar + Multi-font foreground overlay.
